name: TENPO•IS - The Admonitory Rhyme
source:
One for sorrow, two for mirth,
three for a funeral, four for a birth

You can guess it, this is the story of a birth.

It's not the kind of birth you might be more familiar with... but it still won't be nice by any mean.

Follow the clues and unravel this ugly story.

[from [url=https://elis-o.itch.io/tenpo-is]itch.io[/url]]
